HOW MEASURED: the recorded command and the conversion were re-run in the materialised copy at e47493aa with a sys.addaudithook `open` hook in every Python process (sitecustomize on PYTHONPATH), and every opened path inside the copy was kept bar the donor trees and the scratch outputs; every file kept has the same blob at b85e60d2, e47493aa and origin/master 28880431. The completeness row re-derives the static import closure of tool_path and the conversion tool at `revision` (git objects) and requires every module in it to be pinned here or listed in closure_not_loaded, and derives the committed data files those loaded modules name in an os.path.join of string literals, each of which must be pinned by blob, pinned by value (inputs_by_value), listed in data_not_opened, or declared in inputs_excluded. aeon.closure_not_loaded_is: modules in the static import closure of tool_path and the conversion tool at `revision` that the recorded run and the conversion never loaded (they are imported inside functions the run did not call: the audit trace above). Not pinned: a change there cannot move this output unless a pinned file starts calling it, and that change moves a pinned blob.
aeon.data_not_opened_is: committed files a loaded module names (an os.path.join of string literals) that the audit trace saw no process of the recorded run or the conversion open. Not pinned: the output cannot depend on a file nothing opened.

inputs_by_value.why: READ by the tools (the audit trace saw every recorded run open it) and pinned by the VALUES of the constants they read, not by its blob (ROADMAP row 234, replacing row 219's declared exclusion): a blob pin reds on every unrelated constants edit (37 aeon commits in the 30 days to 2026-09-28; days with a currency red over those 30 days: 9 before row 219, 19 under the whole-file pin, 16 with the file excluded, 16 (only 2 of the 37 commits moved a pinned value, 77cf6a71 and 2a727b29, and each also moved a file pinned by blob) under this pin). Read here by: clip_manifest.py (geometry_constants: SECTION_SIZE, MAX_ACT_SECTIONS; player_clearance_px: PLAYER_Y_RADIUS; _const: PLAYER_X_RADIUS); fg_page_order.py (load_budget_constants: its BUDGET_CONSTANTS list, which clip_act_bake and ojz_strip_gen read through it); ojz_strip_gen.py (module level: ART_POOL_PAGE_TILES); layer_lines.py engine_constants (its LL_NAMES, by its own regex; s2_layer_lines reads them through it). NOT READ WHOLESALE: fg_working_set.ConstantSource scans every `const` line but resolves only the names asked for, each by evaluating its right-hand side over the names it mentions, FIRST DEFINITION WINNING; layer_lines takes the first `^pub const NAME = literal`. So each output depends on the file only through the resolved values below, and a value moves whenever its own line, a line it depends on, or an earlier definition of the name moves. The values are aeon's own parsers' answers at `revision` (ConstantSource.get, layer_lines.engine_constants); the provenance row recomputes them with test/support/emp-constants.ts's transcription of those parsers, and the currency row recomputes them at aeon origin/master. names_not_read: constants a loaded module names that this run never reads.
